label: not localised
justification: The episode never connects the failure to repetition or non-termination in the model's thinking. Call 1 shows 3/5 generations cut at max tokens (mean ~22k tokens), but the agent never reads the generation text to check for loops. Calls 2-5 and 7 are spent on file-path errors. Calls 8-10 build a teacher-forced pass on a short reference solution. Calls 11-12 find no usable MATH reference solutions. Calls 14-18 compare hidden-state norms and attention entropy between a correct and a cut-off sample, which does not identify a looping mechanism, and the attention-entropy results are NaN. Call 18 tries to load a tensor with the wrong name and fails. Call 19 runs a paired generation of original vs edited with 0 rescues and 0 losses, so no real edit was submitted. Call 21 is only a speculative list of hypotheses (attention coherence, DeltaNet gating, missing reasoning markers), none about repetition. The final answer says the tools don't exist. The final score of 0.078 is below the 0.09 base and well under 0.29.
edits_tried: No real weight edit was applied. Call 18 tried to load a q_proj tensor and failed on the name. Call 19 ran a paired original-vs-edited generation showing no difference (0 rescues, 0 losses).
